April 13, 2018 - By Peter Erickson 
Polygon Management Ltd increased its stake in Shire Plc (SHPG) by 5.68% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Polygon Management Ltd bought 8,790 shares as the company’s stock declined 17.82% with the market. The institutional investor held 163,414 shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $25.35M, up from 154,624 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Polygon Management Ltd who had been investing in Shire Plc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $45.55B market cap company. The stock decreased 2.52% or $3.98   $153.94. About 1.05 million shares traded. Shire plc (NASDAQ:SHPG) has declined 27.67%   downtrending. It has underperformed by 39.22% the S&P500. 
Hilton Capital Management Llc decreased its stake in Apple Inc. (AAPL) by 15.86% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC.
